title: Mass of online prophecies of 9/11

tellings.quote: there's a million I mean there's a million there uh prophecies whatever you want to call them of 911

plain: The claim is that there were a great many predictions, or prophecies, of the September 11, 2001 attacks on New York posted before they happened. A researcher who writes about prophetic dreams, Eric Wargo, says "there's a million" of them, without naming any one source. If so, it would suggest that people sense major events before they happen.
